countries_thin_or_null: Uruguay — primary BCU methodology pages for current national accounts still reference the 1993 SNA transition materials more prominently than a full public 2008 SNA statement; NCM (MERCOSUR nomenclature) is used for trade classification but the specific uy-mercosur node is not in the provided id list so no cites edge minted

Guyana — strong contextual links between oil production figures and the 2016 PSA exist in official statements, but the PSA itself is not among the listed node ids; no primary Bureau of Statistics methodology page was located that explicitly names the PSA as a data source for gy-petroleo or gy-pib

Suriname — ABS participates in e-GDDS and CPI documentation references COICOP and the CPI Manual, but detailed current national-accounts methodology pages linking sr-pib to a specific SNA edition remain thin

dependencies.basis: Banco Central del Paraguay’s Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales (base year 2014) is compiled under the guidelines of the System of National Accounts 2008 (SCN 2008).
dependencies.evidence_quote: El SCNPY está ajustado a los estándares internacionales vigentes y que están compilados en el Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales del 2008 (SCN 2008), que proporciona los lineamientos estadísticos para la elaboración de un conjunto completo, coherente y flexible de cuentas macroeconómicas

dependencies.basis: Suriname CPI weights and basket are constructed within the framework of COICOP, based on the Household Budget Survey.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The weights used to compile the CPI are based on the 2007/2008 Household Budget Survey (HBS), within the framework of the COICOP.

dependencies.basis: The CPI of Suriname is predominantly compiled following the Consumer Price Index Manual: Theory and Practice 2004.
dependencies.evidence_quote: The CPI of Suriname is predominantly compiled following the Consumer Price Index Manual: Theory and Practice 2004 (ILO, IMF, Organization for Economic Corporation and Development (OECD), Eurostat, United Nations, and the World Bank).

dependencies.basis: Suriname participates in the enhanced General Data Dissemination System; national accounts (GDP) are disseminated under e-GDDS with the National Summary Data Page maintained by ABS.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Enhanced General Data Dissemination System ... Suriname ... National Accounts (GDP)

dependencies.basis: Uruguay merchandise trade statistics are classified using the Nomenclatura Común del MERCOSUR (NCM), which is the regional adaptation of the Harmonized System (HS) for tariff and statistical purposes.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Exportaciones ... Clasificado por NCM ... Importaciones ... Clasificado por NCM
